plan: With a private value of $30, I want to bid strategically. Since this is a second-price sealed bid auction, my optimal strategy is to bid close to, but not exceeding, my true value. Rational opponents will also bid strategically. I'll aim to bid around $29-$30 to maximize potential profit, considering that paying the second-highest bid means I need some margin below my true value.

With a private value of $7, I want to bid strategically. Since this is a single round with no prior history, I'll use a moderate "truth-telling" approach. Rational opponents will likely bid near their own value. I'll bid slightly below my true value to create potential profit margin. A bid around $6 leaves room to potentially win if others bid conservatively, while minimizing overpayment risk if I win.

With a private value of $36, I want to maximize potential profit. Since this is a single round, I'll use a strategic bid that balances winning probability with profit margin. Rational opponents will also be calculating optimal strategies. I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer, anticipating they might bid aggressively.
